newsitem.title: USA: Ford to idle two U.S. plants next week.
newsitem.headline: Ford to idle two U.S. plants next week.

text.p: Ford Motor Co. said Thursday that its Wixom Assembly and Ohio Assembly plants will be idled next week for model changeover and inventory adjustments.

At Wixom, operations will be down to complete a change to the new 1998 Lincoln Town Car. Ford said it will idle the Ohio Assembly facility to maintain dealer inventories of Mercury Villager and Nissan Quest minivans at the end of the 1997 model year.
All other U.S. Ford facilities will resume July 14 after the two-week summer shutdown.

Ford's Canadian assembly plants began a summer shutdown July 7. Operations at the St. Thomas, Ontario, large car plant will resume July 21, while the Ontario truck assembly will resume July 28. Operations at the Oakville, Ontario, light truck facility will resume August 4.

Chrysler Corp said four of its nine U.S. assembly plants and two of its three Canadian plants will operate next week. The company said its Belvidere, Il., St. Louis-North, Newark, Del., Sterling Heights, Mich., and Toledo, Ohio, plants will not operate due to model changeovers.
In Ontario, the Windsor assembly plant will not operate due to model changeover.
